observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Makinig sa concern, gamitin ang kasalukuyang aprubadong gabay, at iugnay si Ana sa midwife o lactation support kung kailangan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Uses reviewed steps, observes respectfully, and refers when the issue exceeds BHW scope.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Magbigay ng tiyak na diagnosis o pamamaraang hindi pa naipapakita ng kwalipikadong trainer.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Give a definite diagnosis or technique not reviewed by a qualified trainer.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Makinig sa concern, gamitin ang kasalukuyang aprubadong gabay, at iugnay si Ana sa midwife o lactation support kung kailangan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Uses reviewed steps, observes respectfully, and refers when the issue exceeds BHW scope.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang pangunahing hakbang ngunit kailangan ng paalala o pagwawasto sa pag-follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Completes the main step but needs a prompt or correction on follow-up.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Magbigay ng tiyak na diagnosis o pamamaraang hindi pa naipapakita ng kwalipikadong trainer.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Give a definite diagnosis or technique not reviewed by a qualified trainer.
